[IRET.13.1] Dispatch is an O(1) index into `ds_builtin_dispatch[]` by the CALL
node's `op` (`ds_lookup_fn(op)`). The table is **global and shared** across
engines (builtins are fixed), zero-initialised in `.bss` (every op starts
unregistered), and populated **once, idempotently** at engine init by the module
register functions. An op that is zero, out of range, or has no registered
handler is refused at load with `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND` ([RDSC.4a.9.3]), so
evaluation never meets one in a loaded artefact; `eval_call` raises an artefact
fault (`DS_FAULT_ARTEFACT`) for one it meets in a network built by hand. Cross-file registration is
first-registrant-wins (a duplicate op re-registers identically; where two
modules could register the same op — e.g. `FN_REGEX_MATCH` — the one that inits
first owns it).
